forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8180'
+title: 'D101: ask for an MCP secret again when Router keeps a sensitive answer out of the mail'
+---
+Blocked by Router ^NBWV8X (01M7JRTP5BNK9GN31Q28NBWV8X) and the Extras flag `ElicitationRequest.sensitive`.
+
+Today (894f64c) `AgentMCPServerSecrets.request` gives nil, because Router mails the content of each elicitation answer to the model (MailBody.elicitationAnswer), and a secret would leak into the model input and the recording.
+
+When Router and Extras are on main:
+- Run `swift package update`.
+- `AgentMCPServerSecrets.request` sends `question(server:key:)` with `sensitive: true` through `ToolContext.current?.elicit`, writes an accepted value to the secret store, and gives the `keychain:` reference. A decline, a cancel or no tool call gives nil.
+- Test (/tdd): a stub session answers the question; the secret store has the value; the recording, the model input (the mail text) and the tool result do not have the value.
+- Tell foundationmodelsmultitool-c9 and testudoapp-75. #D101
\ No newline at end of file
